This is a screw-driven lifting device for extracting stakes, powered by an external impact wrench. The likely candidates are:

- 8425.49 (jacks and hoists, other, non-hydraulic). Heading 8425 covers "jacks; hoists... pulley tackle and hoists other than skip hoists; winches and capstans; jacks of a kind used for raising vehicles". 8425.42 is hydraulic jacks and hoists, other. 8425.49 is other jacks and hoists. The tool is a screw-driven jack-like puller, so 8425.49.00 is plausible. Subheading 8425.49.00 has statistical suffixes: 8425.49.0000 in the HTSUS.
- 8467 (tools for working in the hand, pneumatic, hydraulic, or with self-contained electric or non-electric motor). The tool has no motor, so 8467 does not fit. 8467.99 covers parts of such tools only.
- 8205.59 (hand tools). The stake puller is not powered by its own motor but is operated by an external wrench, so it is not a simple hand tool.

Heading 8425 is the best fit, since it covers jacks and tools that lift or pull by screw action.

{"hts_code": "8425.49.0000", "reason": "A screw-driven, non-hydraulic jack-type lifting/pulling device that applies force through a threaded rod and carriage is classified as other jacks and hoists in heading 8425, subheading 8425.49."}
